perks.name: Force Absorption
perks.description: Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Missile, Rocket Launcher or Grenade Launcher Kill:
20% Area-of-Effect Damage Resist and 60% Explosive Self-Damage Resist for 15 seconds.

Missiles:
Quicksilver Storm's Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Round, Exhaustive Research Rockets, Rocket Frames, Grand Overture Missiles, and Hazardous Propulsion's Exodus Rockets.

perks.name: Reactive Shock
perks.description: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
perks.exact:
While Force Absorption is active:
Being hit by a Melee Attack triggers a Disorienting Burst, disorienting enemies within ? meters for ? seconds.
Can only trigger once per Reactive Shock activation.

item.name: Special Ammo Finder
item.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Special ammo meter.
item.exact:
Special Ammo Finders:
1.25x | 1.4x | 1.5x Ammo Progress Multiplier.

Heavy Ammo Finders:
1.33x | 1.66x | 2x Ammo Progress Multiplier.

item.name: Special Ammo Scout
item.description: When you fill your Special ammo meter, it also creates smaller bricks of Special ammo for your allies.
item.exact:
Upon spawning a Mod-Matching Ammo Brick:
Allies receive a copy of the Ammo Brick.

Ammo Scout Brick Pickup Amounts:
37% | 67% | 100% of a regular Ammo Brick's.

Enhanced Brick Chance is determined by the ally's Weapons Stat.

item.name: Kinetic Siphon
item.description: Rapid Kinetic weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
